in_marathi.name: Arshia
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon Goddess, Bright, Radiant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arshia हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arshia is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Arsha', which means 'moon'. The name is also associated with the brightness and radiance of the moon. In Hindu mythology, Arshia is considered a manifestation of the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, music, and arts. The name is often given to girls in the hopes that they will be blessed with wisdom, knowledge, and creativity.
